clue.text: Butterfly unknown in a country like ours

parts.note: the monarch is a large orange North American butterfly
algebra's unknown quantities are x, y and z, so y stands for an unknown

explanation.surface: A butterfly of uncertain identity turns up in a land much like Britain.
explanation.walkthrough: Written for a British paper, 'a country like ours' points to a kingdom with a crowned head of state.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain is ruled by a sovereign, so a nation of that kind is a kingdom of the same constitutional type.

clue.text: No woman, reportedly, in post

indicators.note: reportedly tells us we are hearing what someone said, so a sound-alike is wanted

parts.note: someone who is no woman is male

explanation.surface: A remark that no woman is in a particular job.
explanation.walkthrough: MALE and the letters entered are pronounced identically.
explanation.definitionFit: Post and letters delivered by the postal service are the same thing in British and American usage.

clue.text: Ducks in American city? How curious

indicators.note: in places the ducks inside the abbreviation for the city

parts.note: NY is short for New York
a duck is a score of nought in cricket, and noughts look like Os

explanation.surface: Someone wonders aloud at waterfowl turning up in a US city.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a batter out without scoring makes a 'duck', so ducks are zeros, written as the letter O. 'How' just turns the definition into an exclamation.
explanation.definitionFit: Being prying about others' affairs is a form of inquisitiveness.

clue.text: Bad weather for gunners in attack

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British Army's gunners
the word in is taken as written, sitting between the two pieces
to storm a position is to attack it

explanation.surface: Artillerymen caught in foul conditions during an assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a container signal but is simply its own letters; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy downpour with wind is a kind of foul meteorological spell.

clue.text: In his line, he is bound to succeed

definitions.text: In his line, he is bound to succeed

parts.words: In his line, he is bound to succeed
parts.note: reads like praise of a talented careerist, but 'line' is a family line of descent and 'succeed' means inherit a title or throne

explanation.surface: A confident prediction that someone will do well in their chosen career.
explanation.definitionFit: The person whose right to inherit cannot be displaced by any later birth is certain to take over the title.

clue.text: Many a beast of burden provided in mountainous area

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so it stands for many
an ass is a donkey used to carry loads
provided, as in 'provided that', means if

explanation.surface: Lots of pack animals are available in hill country.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a compact group of mountains forming one upland block.

clue.text: Small island in the form of a ring

definitions.text: Small island in the form of a ring

parts.words: Small island in the form of a ring
parts.note: a plain description of a ring-shaped coral reef enclosing a lagoon

explanation.surface: A description of a tiny circular island.
explanation.definitionFit: A coral reef islet circling a lagoon is exactly a ring-shaped small island.

clue.text: Details put in shape as demanded for agreement

indicators.note: putting letters in shape means arranging them into a new form

explanation.surface: Fine points are put into order as a contract requires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in shape' rearranges the ten letters of DETAILS PUT; 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Terms specified as a condition of a contract are laid down as required.

clue.text: Gives consumers no choice

parts.note: sounds like a market monopoly, but the consumers are literally eaters made to swallow food

explanation.surface: A complaint about a business leaving shoppers without alternatives.
explanation.definitionFit: Making someone eat against their will leaves the eater no option.

clue.text: Hearten by short pub drink

indicators.note: short asks us to drop the last letter of the word for a pub

parts.note: an inn is a pub
a spirit is a strong alcoholic drink such as gin or whisky

explanation.surface: Being cheered up by a quick drink at the local.
explanation.definitionFit: To encourage someone is to fill them with fresh courage.

clue.text: Plagiarist who's managing to take one in?

indicators.note: to take something in is to hold it within, so one goes inside
completes 'take ... in', putting one inside the manager

parts.note: one who copes or is managing is a coper
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Asking whether a plagiarist is someone able to fool people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take one in' looks like 'deceive someone', fitting a plagiarist; really I goes inside COPER.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who passes off others' work as their own reproduces it without credit.

clue.text: About to take new students up street for drinks

parts.note: re means about or concerning
freshmen are first-year students

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read upwards, from bottom to top

explanation.surface: First-years head up the road for a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ST into TS; 'to take' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Light food and beverages served at an event are a plural word for drinks and snacks.

clue.text: Wrongly place ace with South — use as way to undo contract

indicators.note: placing letters wrongly gives them in a different order

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for South, a bridge player

explanation.surface: A bridge player misplays an ace and puts South in trouble over the contract.
explanation.walkthrough: Bridge words (ace, South, contract) make the surface read like a card game, but 'contract' here is a legal agreement; 'with' and 'as' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A provision letting a party withdraw from an agreement is a legal route out of it.

clue.text: Provide financial advantages to secure comfort in retirement

definitions.meaning: to cushion with subsidies or protected jobs, as a government might an industry
a soft mattress stuffed with plumes, a comfort when one retires for the night

explanation.surface: Arranging money to guarantee an easy old age.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retirement' suggests pensions, but here it is going to bed; 'secure' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Shielding someone with subsidies, and a soft down mattress, are both senses of the same word.

clue.text: Holder of money's taken over rest, perhaps, in Us financial centre

indicators.note: the wallet is taken over the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: a wallet holds money; the 's is 'has'

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of rest may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A purse is grabbed in a New York business district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges the letters of the clue's rest into STRE; 'Us' is just the capitalised abbreviation for the United States, and 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The New York street housing the stock exchange stands for the American finance industry.

clue.text: A source of inspiration liberator can supply

indicators.note: the word can supply some of its own letters as the answer

explanation.surface: A freedom-fighter can provide a source of inspiration.
explanation.definitionFit: She is one of the nine Muses of Greek myth, goddesses who inspire artists, here of love poetry.

clue.text: Charge for carrying mature beer up front

indicators.note: up front puts the beer in front of the word for mature

parts.note: porter is a dark beer
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: Paying for strong beer to be carried along up front.
explanation.definitionFit: The fee paid to a carrier for moving goods or luggage is named after the carrier.

clue.text: Spreading out in river, vessels with a small number on board

indicators.note: in places the vessels and number inside the river

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon
pans are cooking vessels
IV is four in Roman numerals, a small number

explanation.surface: Boats with a few people aboard fan out on a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'on board' are links joining IV to PANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that extends widely is broad in reach.

clue.text: Turns from Norway getting points on TV?

indicators.note: points placed on TV come after it, so the clue's second piece is put first

parts.note: tele is short for television
marks are points scored

explanation.surface: A Norwegian contestant scoring points on a TV show.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the skiing turns named after the Telemark region of Norway.

clue.text: Carry on lawsuit with quiet conduct

parts.note: p, piano, means quiet in music
to lead is to conduct or guide

explanation.surface: Conducting a court case calmly.
explanation.definitionFit: To argue a case in court is to present it as an advocate.

clue.text: Appointment to see an uplifting ceremony

definitions.meaning: a bishop's see is his diocese, and installing him there formally places him in office
a rite that raises someone up onto a throne

explanation.surface: Booking a visit to an inspiring service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' looks like a verb, but it is a bishop's diocese.
explanation.definitionFit: Installing a monarch or bishop on a throne is both a formal appointment and a rite raising someone high.

clue.text: Drive off to find parking in middle of spin

indicators.note: in middle of places parking at the centre of the spin

parts.note: to reel is to spin or whirl
P is the map symbol for parking

explanation.surface: Fending someone off to find a parking spot in a skid.
explanation.definitionFit: To force an attacker back is to repulse them.

clue.text: Salad dressing in short supply in part of Ireland

indicators.note: in short says the dressing's name is clipped to its familiar short form

parts.note: mayonnaise is a salad dressing

explanation.surface: An Irish county runs short of salad dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a county in the west of Ireland, in Connacht.

clue.text: Arrested, it is believed

definitions.meaning: as in 'a view widely ...', meaning maintained

explanation.definitionFit: The past participle of a verb meaning to detain and to maintain as an opinion.

clue.text: Electronically signals British general with extra message

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general
PS, postscript, is a message added to a letter

explanation.surface: A British general sends extra messages electronically.
explanation.definitionFit: Short high-pitched electronic tones are what a pager sends.

clue.text: State secret

definitions.meaning: to hint or make known, a verb

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means declare indirectly; as an adjective, private or confidential.

clue.text: Remains kept by churchwarden, say

parts.note: a churchwarden is also a long clay tobacco pipe, and the remains are unburnt tobacco left in its bowl

explanation.surface: Relics looked after by a parish official.
explanation.walkthrough: A churchwarden is a church officer, but also a long-stemmed clay pipe; 'say' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The plug of half-smoked tobacco left in a pipe bowl is the leftover inside it.

clue.text: A hormone to produce a heavenly body

parts.note: a steroid is a type of hormone such as testosterone

explanation.surface: Taking a hormone to get an attractive physique.
explanation.definitionFit: A small rocky object orbiting the sun is a celestial body.
